{{Quote|Then meet me in three hours at the corner of Starliner and Volbick.|Han Solo to Belindi Kalenda|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
'''Volbick''' was a street in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], during the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Belindi Kalenda]] met where Volbick crossed [[Starliner (street)|Starliner]] in order to attempt to steal a [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]].
